veranderings.blok: Dinge wat gelewe het en nou dood is
veranderings.voor: en daardie tak is dan dood
veranderings.na: en dan is die tak dood
veranderings.rede: Putting 'dan' first reads more naturally, and 'daardie' adds nothing because the branch was just named.

veranderings.blok: Dinge wat gelewe het en nou dood is
veranderings.rede: The repeated 'daardie' is clunky; one 'daardie' covers both nouns without changing the reference.

veranderings.blok: Vuur lyk lewend, maar lewe nie
veranderings.voor: So kan 'n ding selfs lyk asof
veranderings.na: 'n Ding kan dus selfs lyk asof
veranderings.rede: A sentence-initial 'So' meaning 'therefore' leans on English; 'dus' is the natural Afrikaans connector and 'asof' stays.
